liechtenstein.title: Flag of the Principality of Liechtenstein

colors.note: Represents the sky above the Alpine country.
Symbolises the evening fires lit in homes across the mountainous principality.
The princely crown represents the unity of the people with their princely house.

desc:
- Two equal horizontal bands of blue over red, with a gold princely crown in the upper hoist canton
- The crown was added in 1937 after Liechtenstein discovered Haiti used an identical blue-red flag at the 1936 Berlin Olympics
- Adopted on 24 June 1937, the basic bicolour dates to 1921 with antecedents from 1764
trivia:
- The 1936 Olympics incident — discovering Haiti's identical flag — directly prompted adding the crown
- The current crown depiction was redesigned in 1982 to give it a more three-dimensional appearance
- Prince Franz Joseph II chose blue and red as the dynastic colours of the House of Liechtenstein
